notes: Vuori's San Francisco store, named in issue #324, read from the store's own page on 2026-09-12. https://vuoriclothing.com/pages/stores links 132 store pages, two of them filed under San Francisco: the Union Street shop, and 'San Francisco Premium Outlet', which is in Livermore and stays off. The store page carries a schema.org ClothingStore block with the address and coordinates, and prints the hours beside it. Four fetches on 2026-09-11 and 2026-09-12 agreed on all of it. The 20% is Vuori's own wording — its refer-a-friend page reads 'Refer a Friend & Send Them a 20% Off Discount Code' — and the link in the issue carries a member's `sref_id`, so there is one REFERRALS row, `vuori`, for the one shop.

coverage.remaining: None. Vuori's other San Francisco-named store, San Francisco Premium Outlet, is in Livermore.
